The `source` array uses standard Bash variable expansion (`${url}`, `${pkgver}`) to construct a GitHub URL, which is normal PKGBUILD practice and poses no execution risk during sourcing. No malicious code, network requests, or data exfiltration would occur during this command.
</details>
